name: FDC International Hotels Corporation
summary: Based in Taiwan, FDC International Hotels Corporation specializes in the management and operation of international tourist hotels and restaurant facilities. The company's portfolio includes well-known properties such as the Yunpin Hot Spring Hotel Sun Moon Lake, Palais de Chine Hotel Taipei, Gala De Luxe, and Yipin Hotel. Founded in 2012, its primary operations are directed from its headquarters in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
